sources.sensitivity_rule: No J/P or other source partition is treated as ground truth. If a result changes materially across defensible partitions, mark MODEL_DEPENDENT.
sources.translation_rule: Translations may support human inspection but carry zero lexical-match credit unless the Hebrew layer supports the feature.

sources.source_layer_rule: Store/cite the source verbatim. Changing the Tanzil text is forbidden by its terms; normalization and tokenization must be derived layers with separate hashes.
sources.historical_null: Jewish, Christian and wider Late Antique contact/intertextuality remains an active dependence null and blocks naive independence counting.
